capabilities.name: aletia.nexus.read
capabilities.use: The data room's parties, people and the person's role.

capabilities.name: aletia.lens.read
capabilities.use: The request list with documents filed, by status or gaps.

capabilities.name: aletia.arc.read
capabilities.use: One request's history, claims and extracted facts.

capabilities.name: aletia.search
capabilities.use: Documents and records already in the nexus.

capabilities.name: aletia.people.read
capabilities.use: Who in the nexus can be asked.

capabilities.name: aletia.sends.read
capabilities.use: Requests asked of the person by name.

capabilities.name: aletia.expect.write
capabilities.use: Raise or refine requests, after confirmation.

capabilities.name: aletia.supply.write
capabilities.use: File documents against requests, after confirmation.

capabilities.name: aletia.mark.write
capabilities.use: Follow up, answer, or record the person's accept, reject or waive decision.

inputs.name: the signed-in person, their party and role in the data-room nexus
inputs.source: the client's OAuth sign-in through the TAG login; aletia.nexus.read

inputs.name: transaction scope (requesting side)
inputs.source: the person, with references/request-list.md as a starting point

inputs.name: documents to search (responding side)
inputs.source: files the person attaches, a drive connected in their client, aletia.search

outputs.name: request list
outputs.description: Requests with identifier, category, owed by, due date, state and documents filed.

outputs.name: match table
outputs.description: Each request with candidate documents, why each answers it, and gaps.

outputs.name: confirmed writes
outputs.description: Raised, filed or marked items and their identifiers.

conditions: The person confirms every request list, filing, answer or mark before aletia.expect.write, aletia.supply.write or aletia.mark.write is called.
Accepting, rejecting, waiving or closing a request is the requesting side's decision; the skill records it only when that person makes it.
No document is filed that the person has not seen; documents holding more than was asked are flagged before filing.
Access is aletia's decision on every call; the skill never filters, grants or works around a refusal.
